WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    id, name, amount, currency, due_day, owner, remind_offsets,
    date('now', 'localtime') AS today
  FROM bills
  WHERE status = 'unpaid'
),
step1 AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(strftime('%d', today) AS INTEGER) <= due_day
        THEN date(today, 'start of month')
      ELSE date(today, 'start of month', '+1 month')
    END AS month_start
  FROM base
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT *,
    CAST(strftime('%d', date(month_start, '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER) AS last_day
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT *,
    MIN(due_day, last_day) AS clamped_day
  FROM step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT *,
    date(month_start, '+' || (clamped_day - 1) || ' days') AS due_date
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT
    id, name, amount, currency, owner, due_day, due_date, remind_offsets,
    CAST(julianday(due_date) - julianday(today) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_due
  FROM step4
)
SELECT * FROM step5
WHERE ',' || remind_offsets || ',' LIKE '%,' || days_until_due || ',%'
ORDER BY days_until_due
LIMIT 100;

INSERT INTO notifications (created_at, bill_id, message, channel, delivered)

  SELECT
    id, name, amount, currency, due_day, owner, remind_offsets,
    date('now', 'localtime') AS today
  FROM bills
  WHERE status = 'unpaid'
),
step1 AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(strftime('%d', today) AS INTEGER) <= due_day
        THEN date(today, 'start of month')
      ELSE date(today, 'start of month', '+1 month')
    END AS month_start
  FROM base
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT *,
    CAST(strftime('%d', date(month_start, '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER) AS last_day
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT *,
    MIN(due_day, last_day) AS clamped_day
  FROM step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT *,
    date(month_start, '+' || (clamped_day - 1) || ' days') AS due_date
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT
    id, name, amount, currency, owner, due_day, due_date, remind_offsets,
    CAST(julianday(due_date) - julianday(today) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_due
  FROM step4
)
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
  id,
  '[' || owner || '] ' || name || ': ' || printf('%.2f', amount) || ' ' || currency
    || ' due in ' || days_until_due || ' day(s) (due day ' || due_day || ')',
  'sqlite',
  0
FROM step5
WHERE ',' || remind_offsets || ',' LIKE '%,' || days_until_due || ',%';
